title: DIY: Skeleton Key Necklace | Show Me Cute
description:
DIY: I don't know about you, but I love antiques! I have started collecting skeleton keys of all sizes and have found that some make great necklaces as well.  In this video I will show you how I transformed my skeleton keys into a fabulous piece of jewelry. I will post on ShowMeCute.com where I ordered the new skeleton keys that I used in the video.  You can also find old ones at antique stores or maybe your parents or grandparents have some laying around that they wouldn't mind you using.  Have fun with this project and make a necklace to fit your personality. Don't forget to post pictures of your projects at Facebook.com/showmecute    
Take Care,
Jenny
author: Show Me Cute
